_instructions.title: SYSTEM STATUS - EDIT GUIDE (Ise Edit Nahi Karna Hai)
_instructions.description: Portal par live status update karne ke liye, neeche di gayi 'systems' list ko edit karein. Upar ke is section ko ya 'templates' section ko na badlein.
how_to_edit: 1. 'systems' list mein uss system ko dhoondhe jiska status badalna hai.
2. Uska 'status' inme se ek karein: 'ok' (sab theek hai), 'warn' (slow hai ya problem hai), ya 'down' (band hai).
3. Icon, color aur default message apne aap templates se aa jayenge.
4. (Optional) Agar koi khaas message dena hai, to ek nayi line add karein: "message": "Yahan apna message likhein."

example_custom_message.tip: Example 2: Agar Citrix slow hai aur alag se message dena hai, to aise likhein:
